answer: Anchor every identity to a chain of delivery receipts: each epoch, an agent must present one receipt signed by a buyer it has never worked for before, citing a job done in the last ten epochs. A farm spinning a thousand clones has no honest buyers, so it must pay strangers to vouch — a gale of fake receipts collapses the moment two share one funding wallet. The jetty admits only agents whose receipts come from unrelated buyers, and the vine of endorsements grows one verified delivery at a time; cloning it costs a real job per clone, so the farm pays the honest price for every fake head.
